title: Expenses
subtitle: Record project costs and business expenses in one place.
generalBusinessCostsAllocatedToProject: General business costs allocated to the project

capture.title: New expense
capture.subtitle: Saving creates a draft only. The expense enters project costs after you approve it. For general business costs, add allocation lines so they are not left unallocated.
capture.overlapWarningBody: An open vendor bill with the same vendor and a similar NET amount already recognizes Actual. Finalizing a separate expense can double-count unless you link them.
capture.overlapWarningHint: Open the bill and accept a match to this expense after you finalize it, or void the duplicate capture.

detail.title: Expense
detail.draftBanner: This expense was saved as a draft and is not included in project costs yet.
detail.finalizedBanner: The expense was recorded in the project costs.
detail.finalizedEditableBanner: You can edit and save changes while this month is open.
detail.correctionHistoryHint: Original and corrections stay in history.

project_allocation.title: This expense needs project allocation
project_allocation.explain: It is already counted in business costs but not split across projects, so project profitability may be incomplete.
project_allocation.action: Choose a project or split across several projects

classification.title: This expense needs classification
classification.explain: A cost type is missing. Choose a cost category so the system knows where to show it.

approval.title: This expense is not approved yet
approval.explain: It is still a draft and not included in costs. Approve it to include it in calculations.

categoryPolicy.title: Category policy
categoryPolicy.overrideHint: You can change method and period below - this expense keeps your override.

lifecycle.draftHint: Saving creates a draft only. Approve it into costs when the amount is ready.
lifecycle.overheadUnallocatedWarning: This is a general business cost with no project allocation. It will not appear in any project’s Actual Cost or general business costs allocated to the project until you add allocation lines.
lifecycle.companyOnlyOverheadHint: This expense counts in business costs and is not assigned to a project.
lifecycle.sharedUnallocatedWarning: This is a shared cost that has not been split across projects yet. Add allocation so each project’s share appears in project cost.
lifecycle.overheadAllocatedHint: Allocation lines determine which projects receive a share of these general business costs.

promoteVendor.title: Save as vendor
promoteVendor.description: Create or link a vendor from “{name}”. The supplier name on this expense stays as entered.
promoteVendor.success: Vendor linked. Supplier text on this expense was kept.

correction.title: Correct expense
correction.subtitle: Creates a corrected version and preserves history.
correction.historyHint: Correction creates a corrected version and keeps the original records in history.
correction.success: Correction draft created. Approve the replacement when ready.

confirm.finalizeConsequence: The expense will be recorded in the project costs.
confirm.voidConsequence: It will be excluded from all cost figures.
confirm.reverseQuestion: Create a reversing entry for the expense of <amount></amount> from <date></date>?
confirm.reverseConsequence: The original stays in history. A linked negative expense zeros its Actual Cost impact.
confirm.correctQuestion: Create a reversal and a corrected draft for the expense of <amount></amount> from <date></date>?
confirm.correctConsequence: The original stays in history. A reversing entry offsets it, and a new draft holds the corrected amount.

fields.expenseType: What kind of cost is this?
fields.installmentHint: Net Actual is spread evenly across these months. Cash payment is separate.
fields.inventoryStockPurchase: Central stock purchase (not immediate operating cost)
fields.inventoryPurchaseQtyHint: Quantity received into central stock. Expense net is divided into a cost layer by this quantity.
fields.categoryRequiredHint: Choose a category so Actual can classify this cost. Without one it stays as needs classification under other expenses.
fields.internalPayrollWarning: Workforce already computes internal employee payroll. Use this category only for an additional payroll lump sum — not for subcontractors or external labor.
fields.amountTaxModeHint: Choose whether the amount includes VAT. The rate comes from the organization’s active tax rule. Actual Cost and profitability use net.
fields.recurrenceUseDrafts: This does not generate repeating expense rows. Use Recurring drafts to schedule them.

placeholders.target: Leave empty or choose a project

attention.summaryStrip: {count, plural, one {# expense needs action} other {# expenses need action}}

empty.title: Track what the business spends
empty.description: Record materials, subcontractors, rent, and other costs. Start with an amount - details can wait.

empty.title: No expenses on this project yet
empty.description: Record materials, subcontractors, and other direct costs as they happen.

allocation.title: Allocate to projects
allocation.subtitle: Without allocation lines, general or shared business costs stay off every project’s cost.
allocation.empty: Add lines so contractors can see method, period, and which projects receive a share.
allocation.selectTarget: Choose project or general business costs
allocation.autoDriverHint: The system splits NET across eligible projects in the period and stores a historical snapshot.
allocation.unallocatedCallout: No projects selected yet - these general business costs will not land on project Actual Cost.

errors.inclusiveTaxRateRequired: An applicable percentage tax rule is required when the amount includes VAT.
errors.workPackageRequiresProject: A work area requires a project.
errors.directFamilyRequiresProject: Direct project cost requires a project.
errors.overheadFamilyRequiresNoProject: General business costs cannot be used on a project expense.
errors.allocationAmountRequired: Enter an amount for each fixed-amount line.
errors.allocationPercentRequired: Enter a percentage for each percent line.
errors.allocationSumMismatch: Allocation lines must sum exactly to the expense amount.
errors.allocationProjectRequired: Project allocation lines require a project.
errors.allocationOverheadNoProject: General business cost lines cannot reference a project.
errors.notEditable: Only draft expenses can be edited.
errors.notFinalizable: Only draft expenses can be finalized.
errors.notVoidable: Only finalized expenses can be voided.
errors.reversalNotVoidable: Reversal entries cannot be voided again.
errors.alreadyReversed: This expense already has a reversing entry.
errors.notReversible: Only finalized expenses can be reversed.
errors.reversalNotReversible: Reversal entries cannot be reversed again.
errors.adjustmentNotReversible: Adjustment entries cannot be reversed this way.
errors.notAdjustable: Only finalized expenses can receive an adjustment.
errors.currencyMustMatchProject: Expense currency must match the project currency.
errors.currencyMustMatchOrganization: General business cost currency must match the organization currency.
errors.projectExpenseNoAllocations: Project expenses cannot be split across allocation lines.
errors.phaseProjectMismatch: The selected phase does not belong to this project.
errors.invalidYearMonth: Enter a valid year and month.
errors.installmentCountRange: Number of installments must be between 1 and 120.
errors.installmentTotal: Installment total must be a positive amount.
errors.installmentConservation: Installment months must sum exactly to the expense net.
errors.inventoryItemRequired: Choose an inventory item for a stock purchase.
errors.inventoryQtyRequired: Enter the quantity received into stock.
errors.inventoryStockPurchaseIncomplete: Stock purchase expenses need an item and quantity before finalize.
errors.classificationRequired: Choose an expense type before recognizing this cost.

overheadHome.title: General business costs
overheadHome.description: General business costs and shared expenses, plus allocation runs - using the existing expense engine.

notAllowed.title: Not allowed
notAllowed.body: You need permission to view expenses to open this page.

empty.overheadBody: Record rent, insurance, and other general business costs without a project, then allocate them to active work.
empty.sharedBody: Shared costs use the same allocation method as general business costs.
empty.runsBody: Automatic allocation snapshots appear here after you allocate a shared or general business cost.
empty.categoriesTitle: No general business cost categories yet
